model: goal ~ screen + season_start + game_type + strength + zone +      release_type + context + pass_zone + second_pass_zone + shooting_team +      defending_team + (1 | shooter_id) + (1 | goalie_id) + (1 |      game_id)
estimation: Binomial mixed model; penalized iteratively reweighted least squares (glmer, nAGQ = 0).
standardization: Standardized to screened-shot covariates within common-support strata; integrated over estimated normal shooter, goalie, and game intercept distributions using 41 deterministic normal-quantile nodes.
interval_method: Fixed-effect Wald and delta-method 95% intervals. Variance components are held at their fitted estimates.
population: Reviewed, QC-complete CSA Offensive Screen and Clear Sight classified shots with a goalie. Screen-on-pass, posts, and deflection releases excluded. Each included season-strength-location-release stratum contains both groups. This is an association within the observed CSA shot population, not all NHL shot attempts.
